prompt: Rendered in the style of a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling mountain campsite nestled against jagged peaks. On the far left, a tall pine tree stands beside a blue tent, its branches swaying slightly. Next to the blue tent, a man in a red scarf sits on a folding chair, holding a steaming mug. Beside him, a brown dog rests its head on his knee, looking up expectantly. In the center foreground, a large campfire crackles, surrounded by three logs arranged in a triangle. A woman in a yellow jacket points at the fire while talking to a boy in a green hat who is roasting a marshmallow on a stick. The boy looks at the marshmallow intently as it begins to brown. To the right of the fire, a black backpack leans against a rock, next to a silver water bottle lying on its side. Behind the water bottle, a girl in a purple beanie sits on a log, tying her hiking boots. Above her, a hawk circles in the pale sky, visible as a small dark shape. Near the center right, a man in an orange vest hands a map to a woman in a gray coat. She looks at the map closely while he points to a specific trail marker. Behind them, a white camper van is parked with its rear doors open, revealing stacked sleeping bags inside. A cat with orange stripes jumps from the van bumper onto the ground, landing near a pile of firewood. Next to the firewood, a lantern hangs from a low branch, casting a faint glow despite the daylight. On the far right, two teenagers in matching blue jackets stand next to each other, looking toward the distant mountains. One of them holds binoculars up to their eyes. Below them, a pair of hiking poles lies crossed on the grass. In the background, a wooden signpost indicates directions with faded arrows. There is no modern technology like smartphones or laptops visible in the scene. There is no smoke obscuring the faces of the people around the fire. There is no rain or wet ground suggesting recent storm activity.
